example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ধিঙ্গি মেয়ে, কিছুতেই লজ্জা করে না।
example_sentences_in_english: She is a bold girl who feels no shame.
The shameless boys are making a racket on the street.
note: Often used derogatorily for young women or girls exhibiting bold behavior; may derive from the unstable nature of a dinghy boat metaphorically implying recklessness.
